source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.19 (the Outburst rework, round 2; 11 Nov 2026), on rules 1.17, rules 1.8 (Outburst 4.0; docs/design/outburst-4.0-spec.md) and rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0; docs/design/outburst-2.0-proposal.md). Module names from the 2020 Recovered Design Notes.

cycle.text: Begin (2 AP, or 1 AP with Swift) starts a ready design at stage 0 and adds 1 Strain. Pump (1 AP) raises it 1 stage, up to stage 4, plain or with a feeling. Release (1 AP) fires it at ×0.8, ×1.0, ×1.2, ×1.4 or ×1.6 for stages 0 to 4: every plain Pump adds +0.2, and a feeling adds its own step instead. If you are still holding it at the start of your next turn it swells: +1 stage for free and +1 Strain (+2 in Flooded air); from Empathy 7 a swell adds no Strain. One Pump a turn can be free, never more: your first Pump of a fight, or from Empathy 3 one every round. Revert Pump (0 AP) undoes the last Pump you made this turn.

calming.text: At the start of each of your turns you lose 1 Strain, before any swell.
A still turn: end a turn in which you didn't Begin, Pump or Feed and are holding no Outburst, and you lose 1 more Strain.
Fighting it out: your first weapon attack each turn, melee or ranged, removes 1 Strain.
Tending others: the first time each turn you heal, stim, shield or cleanse an ally, you lose 1 Strain.
Let it go (free, on your turn): drop the Outburst you are holding. You lose Strain equal to its stage, but no more than its swells added, and the mana meter rises by 1.
Steady the heart (1 AP, only while holding an Outburst): you lose 1 Strain, and the Outburst doesn't swell at the start of your next turn.

damage.text: A character's Damage school starts from 36 (rules 1.19; 28 in rules 1.17, 20 before). An enemy caster's starts from 24, so that with the flatter stage table its Outbursts deal about what the enemy table was fitted with. A natural 20 on a Bolt's or Lance's roll is a critical: ×1.5 damage, up to ×2.0 with everything on your sheet and gear.

aura.text: While you hold an Outburst with an element, each enemy next to you at the start of your turn takes 5 Elemental damage and the element's stage 1 effect.

resonance.text: When an ally Releases after another ally has Released in the same round, their Release gets +0.2 on its stage multiplier for each ally who Released before them that round, up to +0.4. Only the players' side resonates; enemies never do.

heart_overwatch.text: While you hold an Outburst and watch with it, you Release it as your reaction when an enemy enters its reach.

feed.text: Feed (1 AP): absorb a glyph on your own tile into the Outburst you are holding. It gains 1 stage and the glyph is gone.

second_school.text: A second school rides along with its own option, at half strength, and takes effect after the first. It needs Will Power 5 and costs 10 MP more.

same_school.text: Taking a design's own school a second time is not open yet: it will come with an advanced class. The second copy rides at half strength like any second school. With a different way of the school it adds that way at half. With the same way it deepens it: half again the damage or the healing, half again the push or pull (rounded down, at least 1 tile more), half again the rounds.

default_form.name: Bolt
default_form.text: One target at your aim, within reach: 4 tiles plus your Soul range bonus. You roll Will Power against the target's Defense.

stage_shift.text: An element's stage effects count 1 stage higher in Flooded air and 1 stage lower in Thin air, never below stage 0 or above stage 4.

cost_rules: A design's MP cost is its school's base cost, plus its modules, plus 10 for a second school, plus its tone. That total is multiplied by the Soul cost of the current mana level and reduced by 5% for each point of Insight above 1, down to 5 MP at least. A Right Brain Debuff adds 20%. You pay it when you Begin.

limits.tones: one at Lore Master 1; more from tutors or plates

notes: Every number from rules 1.5 on is provisional. Rules 1.19 (the Outburst rework, round 2): the stage table is ×0.8 +0.2 a stage; the Damage base is 36 for characters and 24 for enemy casters; one free Pump a turn at most; Empathy 7 makes swells cost no Strain; every school reads the stage, the Damage school has four ways to strike, Control can Swap and Status can Silence; a design's own school a second time is defined and shelved. Forms are modules (family 'form', one per design, they take a slot); tones take no slot. Retired modules are listed in 'retired' with what an old design gets instead.

schools.name: Damage
schools.text: Deals 36 damage × your Soul multiplier × the stage multiplier. Pick how it strikes: Strike (the full damage), Finish (×0.8, or ×1.4 against a target at half its HP or less), Brand (×0.8, and the target is Marked for your side) or Drain (×0.8, and you heal for a quarter of the HP it takes). A Raw Outburst deals Soul damage, which ignores armour; one with an element deals Elemental damage, and armour counts half. A Bolt or Lance rolls Will Power against Defense; the area shapes hit without a roll.
schools.identity: The school that ends a fight.

option_text.finish: Finish: ×0.8 damage, or ×1.4 against a target at half its HP or less.
option_text.brand: Brand: ×0.8 damage, and a target it hits is Marked: your side gets +1 to hit it and it can't hide.
option_text.drain: Drain: ×0.8 damage, and you heal for a quarter of the HP it takes.

schools.stack: Shelved. Twice in one design: the same way deals half again its damage; a second way rides at half strength.

schools.name: Buff
schools.text: Works on allies. Pick one: heal 30 × your Healing given × the stage multiplier, or make them Inspired (+2 to hit) or Guarded (+2 Defense) for 2 rounds, 3 rounds from stage 2 and 4 rounds at stage 4.
schools.identity: The school that keeps your side standing.
schools.stack: Shelved. Twice in one design: the same way heals half again as much, or lasts half again as long; a second way rides at half strength.

schools.name: Control
schools.text: Pick one: push the target 3 tiles, pull it 3 tiles, make it Pinned or Slowed for 2 rounds, or swap places with it. The target resists with a Body save; an ally you swap with doesn't resist. The stage counts: the save is 1 harder for every 2 stages, a push or pull is 1 tile longer from stage 2 and 2 longer at stage 4, and Pinned and Slowed last 1 round longer from stage 3.
schools.identity: The school that moves the fight.

option_text.swap: Swap: you and the first creature it reaches trade places. A Bolt only.

schools.stack: Shelved. Twice in one design: the same way pushes or pulls half again as far, or lasts half again as long; a second way rides at half strength.

schools.name: Status
schools.text: Pick one: Fear, Shaken, Confused, a Left Brain Debuff or a Right Brain Debuff for 2 rounds, or Silenced for 1 round. The target resists with a Heart save or a Brain save, depending on the condition. The stage counts: the save is 1 harder for every 2 stages, and the condition lasts 1 round longer from stage 3.
schools.identity: The school that gets inside their heads.
schools.stack: Shelved. Twice in one design: the same way lasts half again as long; a second way rides at half strength.

tones.name: Raw
tones.text: Soul damage, which ignores armour. It has no extra effect.

tones.name: Fire
tones.text: Elemental fire damage: armour counts half.

4.text: Burning for 2 rounds. The fire spreads to enemies next to the target, and the ground under it burns.

tones.name: Storm
tones.text: Elemental lightning damage: armour counts half.

2.text: Ignores half cover. Chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles for half damage.

3.text: Ignores half cover. Chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles for half damage.

4.text: Ignores half cover. Chains to 2 more enemies within 2 tiles for half damage. Each one hit is Shaken unless it passes a Heart save.

tones.name: Frost
tones.text: Elemental frost damage: armour counts half.

1.text: Slowed unless it passes a Body save.

4.text: Slowed, and Pinned for 1 round, with no save.

tones.name: Stone
tones.text: Elemental stone damage. Armour counts half at stage 0. From stage 1, armour counts in full and the hit deals +10 damage.

1.text: Armour counts in full, and the hit deals +10 damage.

2.text: Armour counts in full, and the hit deals +10 damage. Prone unless it passes a Body save.

3.text: Armour counts in full, and the hit deals +10 damage. Prone unless it passes a Body save.

4.text: Armour counts in full, and the hit deals +10 damage. Prone unless it passes a Body save. Rubble rises on the empty tiles around the target.

tones.name: Gale
tones.text: Elemental wind damage: armour counts half.

4.text: Pushes the target 3 tiles, and everyone else within 1 tile of it 2 tiles.

tones.name: Acid
tones.text: Elemental acid damage: armour counts half.

1.text: Corroded unless it passes a Body save.

4.text: Corroded, with no save, and a further −2 Defense while it lasts.

retired.why: Replaced by the Burst shape (radius 1; Rain + Size becomes Burst + Size).
Its sight-free half became Ether; moving an ally is the Narrator's (no engine effect).
Retired: the shapes (Burst, Wave, Lance) and Storm's chains cover more than one target.
Retired: Fire's Burning, Acid's Corroded and the held aura carry damage over time.
Retired: Heart Overwatch does it (release as a reaction when an enemy enters reach).
Retired: holding is the delayed blast now.
Retired: the engine never counted casts; stages do the growing.
Retired in rules 1.17: every Outburst already takes effect when it lands, so the module did nothing and took a slot.

items.name: Move
items.text: Far: the Outburst reaches 8 tiles instead of 4, plus your Soul range bonus. It only changes a Bolt or a Burst; a Wave, Lance or Aura keeps its own length.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Homing
items.text: +2 to the Release roll, and the Outburst ignores half cover. It only matters for a Bolt or Lance: the area shapes don't roll.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Swift
items.text: Begin costs 1 AP instead of 2.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Ether
items.text: The Release needs no line of sight and passes through walls and cover.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Right
items.text: The Status school's conditions are resisted with a Heart save.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Left
items.text: The Status school's conditions are resisted with a Brain save.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Time
items.text: Conditions from the Outburst's school, and from its second school, last 2 rounds longer. An element's stage effects keep their own durations.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Inverse
items.text: Flips a Damage Outburst: instead of harming, it gives each ally it reaches a shield of ×0.7 its damage, and it skips enemies in the area. The Narrator decides what a flipped debuff does.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Size
items.text: The shape grows one step: a Wave is 4 tiles long, a Burst or Aura has radius 2, and a Lance is 6 tiles long. It needs a shape: a Bolt can't use it.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Random
items.text: Costs 10 MP less, but the target is picked at random from every creature within reach, allies included. A Bolt or Burst lands on one of them; a Wave or Lance points at one.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: At Once
items.text: A Bolt or Lance hits without a roll, for ×0.8 damage. The area shapes never roll anyway.
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Wave
items.text: Shape: a cone 3 tiles long from you toward your aim (4 with Size). It hits everyone in it without a roll, for ×0.7 damage.
items.look: a violet crescent rolling off your chest

items.name: Burst
items.text: Shape: every tile within 1 of the tile you aim at (within 2 with Size). It hits everyone in it without a roll, for ×0.7 damage.
items.look: a heart-shaped bloom opening at the aim

items.name: Aura
items.text: Shape: every tile within 1 of you, all at once (within 2 with Size). You don't aim it. It never touches you, unless it is a Buff. It deals ×0.6 damage.
items.look: a ring of violet heat breaking off you

items.name: Lance
items.text: Shape: a straight line 4 tiles long from you toward your aim, in any of the 8 directions (6 tiles with Size). It pierces everyone on the line, but walls stop it. You roll against each target, for ×0.8 damage.
items.look: a narrow violet spear of light

items.name: Split
items.text: Bolt only. It also hits the nearest other creature within 2 tiles of your target that the school can affect, at full strength.

items.name: Ricochet
items.text: A Bolt bounces off walls and cover. If there is a wall or cover within 2 tiles of your target, it needs no line of sight and ignores half cover.

items.name: Fuse
items.text: The Release lands and waits. It goes off at the start of your next turn, or when a creature steps into its area, whichever comes first.

items.name: Return
items.text: A Bolt or Lance goes out and comes back: each target is hit a second time for ×0.3 damage. Each hit rolls on its own.

items.name: Volley
items.text: A Bolt becomes 3 small bolts at the same target. Each rolls on its own and deals ×0.4 damage.

items.name: Bloom
items.text: A Burst or Aura grows by 1 radius for each stage it has reached.

items.name: Anchor
items.text: Each target hit is Pinned for 1 round unless it passes a Body save.

items.name: Lure
items.text: Each target hit is pulled 2 tiles toward you.

items.name: Shell
items.text: When you Release, you gain a shield equal to a third of the Outburst's damage.

items.name: Linger
items.text: The area stays as a field for 2 rounds. A Damage field deals 5 damage and the element's stage 1 effect to each enemy that starts its turn there; a Buff field heals each ally that starts their turn there for 5.

items.name: Quiet
items.text: Holding the Outburst adds half the usual Strain, rounded down, from Begin, swells and feelings. In return the Release is at ×0.8 strength.

items.name: Silent
items.text: Begin, Pump and Release don't reveal you while you are Hidden.

items.name: Thread
items.text: A Buff Release links the first two allies it reaches. The next time one of them is healed, the other heals the same amount. It works once.

items.name: Echo
items.text: The Outburst casts again on your next turn at half strength. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Cascade
items.text: It hits 1 more target for each stage it has reached. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Tether
items.text: A beam runs between you and an ally and hits whatever crosses it. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Siphon
items.text: It steals MP from the target. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Phantom
items.text: It passes through cover. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Orbit
items.text: It circles you for 2 rounds and hits whatever comes near. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Volatile
items.text: A target it kills explodes. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Bastion
items.text: Every ally in the shape gains the Shell shield. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Judgement-mark
items.text: The target takes 25% more damage from every source for 1 round. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

items.name: Halo
items.text: The Release also gives the blessing of a Whisper. It can only be learned with its advanced class, which isn't available yet.

practice.text: Each Release earns 1 practice, +1 for each stage it reached past stage 1, and +1 for each feeling poured in. A wild Release earns none. You pick a new module at 5 practice, another at 15, then one every 15 after that. Each Mastery level (3, 5, 7 and 9 points) in a skill that unlocks modules adds 5 practice, and Mastering one (10 points) gives a free pick from the modules it unlocks.

gates.text: To learn a module you need 2 points in the skill that unlocks it, or 4 points for the stronger modules. That holds however you learn it: by practice, a Mastered pick, a Heart plate or a tutor. A module the Narrator grants, or one used in the Proving Ground, needs no skill points. You can only build designs from modules you know.

designs.name: Heart Bolt
designs.text: Damage to one target, with a reach of 8 tiles (Move).

start.text: A new Soul caster starts with 3 designs (a design you pick at creation replaces Heart Bolt), the Damage, Buff and Control schools, the Wave shape and the Move module (Bolt is always available), 2 feelings, and one tone if they have Lore Master 1.

templates.name: Heart Bolt
templates.text: Damage to one target, with a reach of 8 tiles (Move).

residue.text: The strongest feeling poured into an Outburst leaves its residue on every tile the Release covered, for 2 rounds.

stage_riders.text: Control, Status and the Buff school's Inspired and Guarded read the stage too. For every 2 stages the target's save is 1 harder. From stage 3 a condition lasts 1 round longer. A push or pull is 1 tile longer from stage 2 and 2 tiles longer at stage 4. Inspired and Guarded last 1 round longer from stage 2 and 2 rounds longer at stage 4.
